name: Manta
registryCustodian: Gobierno Autónomo Descentralizado Municipal del Cantón Manta, Dirección de Avalúos y Catastro
queryAndRequestOutcome: Separate English and Spanish first-party discovery found the municipal GeoManta viewer and predial procedures. Following the viewer JavaScript reached public GeoServer WMS/WFS capabilities. WFS schema and a bounded EPSG:4326 GetFeature request returned three parcel polygons with safe native identifiers lote_id/clavecatastral; the general application list route returned an authentication HTML page.
scopeLimits: The three-feature bbox is a bounded sample, not a citywide parcel extract.
The municipal report's cadastral-unit counts are contextual and do not prove every unit has public geometry.
The exact WUP point [-0.969966482756839, -80.7128401246128] was preserved and not shifted; nearby sample geometry was not used as an exact-point hit or absence test.
WFS public access does not by itself establish production adapter quality, update cadence, or complete coverage.
sourceSpecificFields: The source schema exposes lote_id and clavecatastral as native parcel identity candidates plus geom. The retained GeoJSON uses only canonical properties.id derived from lote_id; no raw source attribute set is retained.
qualification: Not qualified for runtime integration or admission; the serial reviewer must independently verify the route, field mapping, CRS handling, and safe identifier choice.
uncertainty: The route is public and geometry-verified for the bounded request, but the viewer's application JSON route showed an authentication page without its session, and citywide coverage was not exhaustively tested. No credentials, private tokens, owner/address data, or unsafe fields were requested.
